scientific_findings.finding: The half-trace-absolute-value identity is proved for the difference of normalized finite complex density states. The proof derives its trace-zero condition and constructs an actual legal spectral effect attaining the bound. Equal-prior optimal discrimination and supplied PSD support or unitary-data certificates are separate actual statements; optimality is not assumed as a certificate premise.
scientific_findings.controls: Noncommuting rational mixed-state distance 1/2 and success 3/4; imaginary phase states separated with distance 1 while all real/diagonal effects miss them; nonzero-trace and overlapping-PSD-split counterexamples.
scientific_findings.limits: No arbitrary-matrix norm hierarchy, arbitrary-prior theorem, numerical eigensolver certification, stabilized distance or diamond norm is claimed.

scientific_findings.finding: Full convex purity is converted by the existing actual characterization into vectors before proving the rank bound. A supported spectral Gram factor attains the bound: purification on a specified finite carrier exists iff matrix rank does not exceed its cardinality. Direct auxiliary action has the explicit source-to-target dimension order; strict embeddings are not bilateral unitaries.
scientific_findings.controls: Exact complex 2-to-3 matrix, transpose/vectorization direction and equal marginals; J†J=I but JJ†≠I, reverse full isometry impossible; rank-two and rank-one examples, empty auxiliary excluded for a density state.
scientific_findings.limits: No infinite-dimensional, approximate-rank or physical preparation complexity claim. Two Matrix rank library lemmas are classified externally in the normalized binding, preserving author snapshots.

scientific_findings.finding: The original complete finite stopping tree is embedded into an actual constructed Option-tagged instrument and a deterministic classical history controller. Full record operators agree on valid encodings for arbitrary complex matrices and vanish on invalid histories. A legal effect extension proves isometric full-effect distance preservation and original-leaf return. The budget uses actual reference-implementation prefix weights and zero idle defect.
scientific_findings.controls: Reference continuation mass 1/4 times exact action defect 1/4 gives original and padded record TV=1/16. Different stopping rules have record TV=1 with identical terminal quantum memory, outside the common-rule premise.
scientific_findings.limits: The uniform epsilon corollary assumes the bound at every history including zero-weight histories. No coherent controller, arbitrary external environment, unbounded stopping or infinite conditional process is inferred.
